cohort: A population-based cohort of 602,095 deliveries in Norway between 1999 and 2014, including both immigrant and Norwegian-born women.
finding: Significant differences in intrapartum epidural use were observed among women born in different parts of the world, with increased odds for women from Latin America and reduced odds for women from Sub-Saharan Africa and East Asia/Pacific areas compared to Norwegian-born women.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery increased the odds for intrapartum epidural analgesia use.
